"المرحلة 1 — بناء الأساس الرئيسي للعبة

Build the foundation of a massive, realistic, living-world country and civilization simulation game. This is the first development stage of a much larger project. Do not attempt to build all systems yet.

1. Core concept

Create a realistic world simulation where the player can govern an existing country, create a fictional country, or create a custom world.

The game must be genuinely interactive, visually immersive, expandable, and designed to support many complex systems in future development stages.

The interface language must be Arabic, with complete RTL support. However, countries in the game are not limited to Arabic-speaking countries.

2. Visual identity

Create a completely new, premium, beautiful visual identity for the game.

Use:

- Elegant iOS 26 Liquid Glass-inspired interface.
- Soft translucent glass panels, realistic depth, subtle reflections, beautiful shadows, and smooth animations.
- A sophisticated color palette based on deep forest green, warm ivory, muted bronze, soft stone, and natural complementary colors.
- Beautiful typography, excellent spacing, and readable Arabic text.
- Natural colors that are comfortable for long gameplay sessions.
- A visually rich world, avoiding generic AI-generated purple and neon-blue interfaces.

Do not make the interface cluttered. Every screen should look professionally designed.

3. Main menu

Create a beautiful immersive opening screen with:

- New Game — لعبة جديدة
- Continue — متابعة
- Custom World — عالم مخصص
- Scenarios — سيناريوهات
- Settings — الإعدادات

The main screen must feel like entering a living world, not opening an ordinary management dashboard.

Use a beautiful animated background with a world globe, subtle lighting, clouds, or an atmospheric world scene if technically possible.

4. New game creation

When the player presses New Game, open a multi-step game setup wizard.

Step 1 — Choose your world

Allow the player to choose:

- Real world.
- Fictional world.
- Custom world.
- Historical scenario.
- Modern scenario.

Step 2 — Choose your country

Allow selecting any country in the world, not only Arab countries.

Also provide the option to create a completely fictional country.

Step 3 — Country identity

Provide customization for:

- Country name in Arabic.
- International name.
- Flag.
- National emblem.
- National language or multiple languages.
- Capital city.
- Currency.
- National identity.
- Geographic territory.

Step 4 — Government

Allow selecting a government type, including:

- Republic.
- Presidential system.
- Parliamentary system.
- Constitutional monarchy.
- Absolute monarchy.
- Federal government.
- Military government.
- Dictatorship.
- One-party system.
- Technocratic government.
- Custom system.

The selected system should determine the structure and difficulty of future political gameplay.

Step 5 — Starting conditions

Allow the player to configure:

- Population.
- Treasury.
- National debt.
- Economic development.
- Infrastructure.
- Education.
- Healthcare.
- Energy.
- Agriculture.
- Industry.
- Natural resources.
- Political stability.
- International relations.

Provide two options: Quick Start and Advanced Setup.

5. Game interface foundation

Create the main in-game interface as a separate screen from the main menu.

It must contain an expandable navigation system with these initial sections:

- World — العالم
- Government — الحكومة
- Economy — الاقتصاد
- Population — السكان
- Infrastructure — البنية التحتية
- Projects — المشاريع
- Statistics — الإحصائيات
- Events — الأحداث

These sections must be functional navigation elements, even if their advanced systems will be developed in later stages.

Do not fill these pages with fake statistics or pretend that incomplete systems are already functioning.

6. Simulation controls

Create a persistent simulation control panel containing:

- Pause.
- Play.
- Three simulation speeds.
- Current in-game date.
- Notifications.
- Save game.

Simulation controls must be prepared to connect to the actual simulation engine in later stages.

7. Save system

Implement a basic functional save system if supported.

- Save the current game.
- Continue the last saved game.
- Preserve country setup.
- Preserve selected settings.
- Allow multiple saved games if possible.

8. Mobile-first design

The entire game must work on Android phones and mobile browsers.

- Responsive layouts.
- Touch-friendly buttons.
- No desktop-only interactions.
- No tiny text.
- No horizontal overflow.
- Panels and menus should adapt to the screen.
- Landscape and portrait layouts should be considered.

9. Technical architecture

Build this project in a modular way.

Keep the main menu, game setup, simulation interface, navigation, settings, and future game systems separate.

Do not create a single enormous unstructured component.

Make it possible to add future systems without rewriting the foundation.

10. Important restrictions

- Do not create a generic dashboard.
- Do not make the game primarily a collection of statistics, text, and charts.
- Do not use fake maps or decorative polygons as a replacement for real geography.
- Do not pretend that features are functional if they are not.
- Do not remove or simplify the specified features.
- Do not build the entire game at once.
- Prioritize quality, visual polish, and a functional foundation.
- Keep the project running and test the main interactions.

Deliverable: A working first version of the game containing the visual identity, main menu, new-game wizard, country configuration, government selection, starting conditions, initial navigation, simulation controls, and basic save/continue functionality. This foundation will be extended in subsequent development stages.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

The start script expects either package.json with vite, or index.html plain. For this complex app, Vite + React would be ideal. Let me check node/npm availability and internet access. We can use React + Vite. But we need to be careful with offline availability. Let's check if npm install works.

We should decide architecture: Vite + React + TypeScript? Or plain HTML/JS with modules? A rich game needs state management. React is fine. Let me check node version and npm cache/network.

Let me think deeply about the product design because the quality bar is high.

The request: Arabic RTL country/civilization simulation game foundation, stage 1. Premium "iOS 26 Liquid Glass" visual identity. Main menu with animated globe/world atmosphere. New game wizard 5 steps. In-game interface with expandable nav (8 sections) and persistent simulation controls (pause/play/3 speeds/date/notifications/save). Save system with multiple saves, continue. Mobile-first.

Need to avoid fake stats. In-game pages must be functional navigation but not filled with fake statistics. We can show real setup data (population, treasury, etc from starting conditions) — that's not fake, it's player-configured. Show honest "under development" placeholders for systems not built. But also don't make it a generic dashboard.

We need real geography — "Do not use fake maps or decorative polygons as a replacement for real geography." We need real world map data. Could use GeoJSON world map data (Natural Earth) bundled locally. We can fetch from a CDN at build time and store in repo as JSON. For country selection, real countries with Arabic names. Need flag rendering - emoji flags or SVG flags from CDN? Emoji flags work on most platforms but Windows doesn't support them. We can use SVG flags via a package like `flag-icons` or fetch from flagcdn. Better to bundle flag SVGs? There are 250 countries — quite a lot but okay maybe several MB. Alternatively use `circle-flags` package. Hmm.

Let me check network availability for npm and CDN.

  GOVERNMENTS.map((g) => [g.id, g]),
) as Record<GovernmentId, GovernmentDefinition>

export function defaultGovernment(): GovernmentConfig {
  return {
    id: 'republic',
    customName: '',
    customDescription: '',
    centralization: 55,
    transparency: 60,
    militaryInfluence: 25,
  }
}

export function governmentDisplayName(config: GovernmentConfig): string {
  if (config.id === 'custom') {
    return config.customName.trim() || 'نظام مخصص'
  }
  return GOVERNMENT_BY_ID[config.id]?.nameAr ?? 'نظام حكومي'
}

export function governmentDifficultyLabel(d: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4): string {
  return ['متوازن', 'متوسط', 'صعب', 'شديد'][d - 1]
}

## Objective
- Build a complete Arabic RTL, mobile-first foundation for a realistic country/civilization simulation game named نيـروز, including the main menu, game setup wizard, live game interface, and local save system.

## Requirements
- Interface language: Arabic with complete RTL support.
- Countries are not limited to Arab countries.
- Premium iOS 26 Liquid Glass-inspired visual identity using deep forest green, ivory, muted bronze, stone, and natural colors.
- Immersive animated main menu with a real-world globe.
- Multi-step creation wizard covering world type, country selection/fictional country, identity, government, and starting conditions.
- Functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events.
- Persistent simulation controls for pause/play, speed, date, notifications, and saving.
- Real geography; no fake-map or decorative-polygon substitution.
- Mobile-first responsive layout for portrait and landscape.
- Modular architecture and basic real save/continue support.
- Do not present incomplete systems as fully functioning.

## Decisions
- Built from scratch in the existing workspace using React 19, Vite, TypeScript, and the installed data/globe libraries.
- Used real `world-atlas` geographic data, `d3-geo`, `topojson-client`, and country flag SVG assets.
- Used locally bundled Arabic-capable fonts; interface and country metadata remain modular.
- Assumed 2026 as the modern starting year.
- Chose localStorage for the foundation save system.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project and package foundation established with React, Vite, TypeScript, D3, TopoJSON, world-atlas, and Lucide.
- Country dataset generated from world-countries, World Bank, Wikidata, and curated fallback data.
- Real-country, fictional-country, identity, government, scenarios, settings, and save data modules created.
- Premium glass visual system and responsive CSS were implemented.
- Interactive world globe and SVG world map components were created.
- Core main-menu, wizard, scenario, settings, saves, and game interface components were implemented.
- Local save storage, continue, rename, delete, active-state, and settings persistence were implemented.

### Active
- The project has substantially been implemented, but UI/screens and wizard integration may still require final validation and bug fixes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Start the Vite project and verify dependencies and TypeScript compilation.
2. Run the app in a browser at desktop and mobile viewports.
3. Test the complete New Game flow and country-selection interactions.
4. Test continue, save, rename, delete, and simulation-control behavior.
5. Fix any runtime, layout, overflow, RTL, or component integration issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/package.json`: Project dependencies and scripts.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/App.tsx`: Main application screen routing and top-level composition.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Game context, simulation state, saves, notifications, and settings.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/game/storage.ts`: LocalStorage save implementation.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/game/setup.ts`: Wizard draft creation and validation.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/game/types.ts`: Core game state and data types.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: Immersive opening screen.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/screens/wizard/`: Multi-step game setup screens.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/screens/game/`: In-game navigation and section screens.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/components/WorldGlobe.tsx`: Animated interactive globe.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geographic SVG world map.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/data/countries.json`: Generated world-country dataset.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/data/governments.ts`: Government definitions and profiles.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/styles/base.css`: Global visual foundation.
- `/home/runner/work/Newroz/Newroz/src/styles/game.css`: In-game responsive layout.

## Important Context
- The implementation deliberately does not expose advanced economy, military, diplomacy, population-growth, or project systems as live simulation systems.
- Several historical/scenario conditions are explicitly marked as estimates rather than official historical statistics.
- Local data and saves are browser-specific; no backend or cloud synchronization exists yet.
- The project should be checked for any final unintegrated imports or component/export mismatches.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

Build the foundation of a massive, realistic, living-world country and civilization simulation game. This is the first development stage of a much larger project. Do not attempt to build all systems yet.

1. Core concept

Create a realistic world simulation where the player can govern an existing country, create a fictional country, or create a custom world.

The game must be genuinely interactive, visually immersive, expandable, and designed to support many complex systems in future development stages.

The interface language must be Arabic, with complete RTL support. However, countries in the game are not limited to Arabic-speaking countries.

2. Visual identity

Create a completely new, premium, beautiful visual identity for the game.

Use:

- Elegant iOS 26 Liquid Glass-inspired interface.
- Soft translucent glass panels, realistic depth, subtle reflections, beautiful shadows, and smooth animations.
- A sophisticated color palette based on deep forest green, warm ivory, muted bronze, soft stone, and natural complementary colors.
- Beautiful typography, excellent spacing, and readable Arabic text.
- Natural colors that are comfortable for long gameplay sessions.
- A visually rich world, avoiding generic AI-generated purple and neon-blue interfaces.

Do not make the interface cluttered. Every screen should look professionally designed.

3. Main menu

Create a beautiful immersive opening screen with:

- New Game — لعبة جديدة
- Continue — متابعة
- Custom World — عالم مخصص
- Scenarios — سيناريوهات
- Settings — الإعدادات

The main screen must feel like entering a living world, not opening an ordinary management dashboard.

Use a beautiful animated background with a world globe, subtle lighting, clouds, or an atmospheric world scene if technically possible.

4. New game creation

When the player presses New Game, open a multi-step game setup wizard.

Step 1 — Choose your world

Allow the player to choose:

- Real world.
- Fictional world.
- Custom world.
- Historical scenario.
- Modern scenario.

Step 2 — Choose your country

Allow selecting any country in the world, not only Arab countries.

Also provide the option to create a completely fictional country.

Step 3 — Country identity

Provide customization for:

- Country name in Arabic.
- International name.
- Flag.
- National emblem.
- National language or multiple languages.
- Capital city.
- Currency.
- National identity.
- Geographic territory.

Step 4 — Government

Allow selecting a government type, including:

- Republic.
- Presidential system.
- Parliamentary system.
- Constitutional monarchy.
- Absolute monarchy.
- Federal government.
- Military government.
- Dictatorship.
- One-party system.
- Technocratic government.
- Custom system.

The selected system should determine the structure and difficulty of future political gameplay.

Step 5 — Starting conditions

Allow the player to configure:

- Population.
- Treasury.
- National debt.
- Economic development.
- Infrastructure.
- Education.
- Healthcare.
- Energy.
- Agriculture.
- Industry.
- Natural resources.
- Political stability.
- International relations.

Provide two options: Quick Start and Advanced Setup.

5. Game interface foundation

Create the main in-game interface as a separate screen from the main menu.

It must contain an expandable navigation system with these initial sections:

- World — العالم
- Government — الحكومة
- Economy — الاقتصاد
- Population — السكان
- Infrastructure — البنية التحتية
- Projects — المشاريع
- Statistics — الإحصائيات
- Events — الأحداث

These sections must be functional navigation elements, even if their advanced systems will be developed in later stages.

Do not fill these pages with fake statistics or pretend that incomplete systems are already functioning.

6. Simulation controls

Create a persistent simulation control panel containing:

- Pause.
- Play.
- Three simulation speeds.
- Current in-game date.
- Notifications.
- Save game.

Simulation controls must be prepared to connect to the actual simulation engine in later stages.

7. Save system

Implement a basic functional save system if supported.

- Save the current game.
- Continue the last saved game.
- Preserve country setup.
- Preserve selected settings.
- Allow multiple saved games if possible.

8. Mobile-first design

The entire game must work on Android phones and mobile browsers.

- Responsive layouts.
- Touch-friendly buttons.
- No desktop-only interactions.
- No tiny text.
- No horizontal overflow.
- Panels and menus should adapt to the screen.
- Landscape and portrait layouts should be considered.

9. Technical architecture

Build this project in a modular way.

Keep the main menu, game setup, simulation interface, navigation, settings, and future game systems separate.

Do not create a single enormous unstructured component.

Make it possible to add future systems without rewriting the foundation.

10. Important restrictions

- Do not create a generic dashboard.
- Do not make the game primarily a collection of statistics, text, and charts.
- Do not use fake maps or decorative polygons as a replacement for real geography.
- Do not pretend that features are functional if they are not.
- Do not remove or simplify the specified features.
- Do not build the entire game at once.
- Prioritize quality, visual polish, and a functional foundation.
- Keep the project running and test the main interactions.

Deliverable: A working first version of the game containing the visual identity, main menu, new-game wizard, country configuration, government selection, starting conditions, initial navigation, simulation controls, and basic save/continue functionality. This foundation will be extended in subsequent development stages.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete the existing نيـروز project as a polished, Arabic RTL foundation for a realistic country and civilization simulation, including setup, navigation, simulation controls, and local saves.
- Keep the scope to a functional first stage; do not present future systems as already implemented.

## Requirements
- Premium, mobile-first Arabic RTL interface with a deep-green, ivory, bronze, and natural palette; immersive animated globe; responsive portrait and landscape layouts.
- Support real, fictional, custom, historical, and modern worlds; country selection must include countries worldwide and use real geography.
- Provide a five-step setup wizard for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions, including Quick Start and Advanced Setup.
- Include functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events without fabricating incomplete systems.
- Provide pause/play, three speeds, date, notifications, and save controls; support multiple local saves and continuing a saved game.
- Keep the architecture modular and test the main interactions; do not build the full simulation yet.

## Decisions
- Use the existing React 19, Vite, TypeScript project structure and installed geography/globe libraries.
- Use real `world-atlas` geography and D3/TopoJSON, Arabic-localized UI and data, and localStorage for saves.
- Treat advanced simulation systems as future work and label setup-only values and estimates clearly.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing foundation includes game data, screens, components, styling, real-world map/globe, wizard, and local save/settings implementation, as recorded in the prior checkpoint.
- Added/updated app entry and project configuration: `index.html`, `vite.config.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `src/vite-env.d.ts`, `src/main.tsx`; changed the build script in `package.json`.
- Added `src/game/draft.ts` for wizard draft operations and created wizard shared parts plus step components, including `WorldStep`, `CountryStep`, `IdentityStep`, `GovernmentStep`, and `ConditionsStep`.

### Active
- Integrate and validate the recent wizard work with the existing app; inspect for missing, mismatched, or incomplete imports and exports.
- Run TypeScript/build checks and test the full wizard, navigation, controls, and save flows.
- Check browser behavior at desktop and mobile sizes, especially RTL, overflow, and map/country interactions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/App.tsx` and wizard directory to confirm all recently created screens and steps are wired together and exports/imports match.
2. Run dependency installation if needed, then run the TypeScript/build checks; fix compilation and runtime errors.
3. Launch the app and test New Game, country selection, setup completion, Continue, multiple saves, rename/delete, settings persistence, and simulation controls.
4. Verify desktop and mobile layouts and address any RTL, overflow, or interaction issues.

## Relevant Files
- `package.json`: Dependencies and build scripts.
- `index.html`: Arabic RTL document shell and metadata.
- `vite.config.ts`: Vite configuration.
- `tsconfig.json`: TypeScript configuration.
- `src/main.tsx`: React entry point, providers, and stylesheet imports.
- `src/App.tsx`: Top-level screen routing and composition.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: Wizard draft transformations.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Game context, simulation state, saves, notifications, and settings.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: Wizard draft creation and validation.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: Local save implementation.
- `src/screens/wizard/`: Wizard shared parts and step screens.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geographic SVG map.
- `src/components/WorldGlobe.tsx`: Animated globe.
- `src/data/countries.json`: Generated country dataset.
- `src/styles/`: Global, menu, wizard, game, and page styling.

## Important Context
- Recent file writes and edits are unverified; tool outputs for several large writes were omitted or truncated.
- Changes are not known to be committed; the last observed `git status --short` was clean before the recent writes.
- No build, browser, or interaction tests have yet been reported for the recent changes.
- No backend or cloud synchronization; saves and settings are browser-local.
- The user explicitly requested a working, tested first version and reasonable assumptions without clarification.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete the existing نيـروز project as a polished, Arabic RTL foundation for a realistic country and civilization simulation.
- Deliver a working first version with setup, navigation, simulation controls, and local saves without pretending future systems are implemented.

## Requirements
- Premium, mobile-first Arabic RTL design with deep green, warm ivory, bronze, natural colors, and an immersive animated globe.
- Support real, fictional, custom, historical, and modern worlds; country selection must include countries worldwide and use real geography.
- Provide a five-step setup wizard for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions, including Quick Start and Advanced Setup.
- Include functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events without fabricated systems.
- Provide pause/play, three speeds, date, notifications, and save controls; support multiple local saves and continuing a saved game.
- Keep the architecture modular, test the main interactions, and do not build the full simulation yet.

## Decisions
- Use the existing React 19, Vite, TypeScript project structure and installed geography/globe libraries.
- Use real `world-atlas` geography and D3/TopoJSON, Arabic-localized UI and data, and localStorage for saves.
- Clearly label setup-only values and estimates; advanced simulation systems remain future work.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing foundation includes game data, screens, components, styling, real-world map/globe, wizard, and local save/settings implementation.
- Added/updated the app entry and project configuration, including `index.html`, `vite.config.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `src/vite-env.d.ts`, `src/main.tsx`, and the build script in `package.json`.
- Added `src/game/draft.ts` and wizard shared parts and step components for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions.

### Active
- Integrate and validate the recent wizard work with the existing app; inspect `src/App.tsx` and wizard imports/exports.
- Run TypeScript/build checks and test wizard, navigation, controls, and save flows.
- Check browser behavior at desktop and mobile sizes, especially RTL, overflow, and map/country interactions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/App.tsx` and `src/screens/wizard/` to verify wiring and imports/exports.
2. Install dependencies if needed; run TypeScript and build checks, then fix compilation or runtime errors.
3. Launch the app and test New Game, country selection, setup completion, Continue, multiple saves, rename/delete, settings persistence, and simulation controls.
4. Verify desktop and mobile layouts; address RTL, overflow, and interaction issues.

## Relevant Files
- `package.json`: Dependencies and build scripts.
- `src/App.tsx`: Top-level screen routing and composition.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Simulation state, saves, notifications, and settings.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: Wizard draft transformations.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: Wizard draft creation and validation.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: Local save implementation.
- `src/screens/wizard/`: Shared parts and wizard step screens.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geographic SVG map.
- `src/components/WorldGlobe.tsx`: Animated globe.
- `src/data/countries.json`: Country dataset.
- `src/styles/`: Global, menu, wizard, game, and page styling.
- `src/main.tsx`: React entry point, providers, and stylesheet imports.

## Important Context
- Recent file writes and edits are unverified; several large-write tool outputs were omitted or truncated.
- Changes are not known to be committed; the last observed `git status --short` was clean before recent writes.
- No build, browser, or interaction tests have been reported for the recent changes.
- Saves and settings are browser-local; there is no backend or cloud synchronization.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete نيـروز as a polished Arabic RTL foundation for a realistic country and civilization simulation.
- Deliver a working first version with setup, navigation, simulation controls, and local saves without presenting future systems as implemented.

## Requirements
- Premium, mobile-first Arabic RTL design with deep green, warm ivory, bronze, natural colors, and an immersive animated globe.
- Support real, fictional, custom, historical, and modern worlds; country selection should cover countries worldwide and use real geography.
- Provide a five-step setup wizard for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions, including Quick Start and Advanced Setup.
- Include functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events without fabricated systems.
- Provide pause/play, three speeds, date, notifications, and save controls; support multiple local saves and continuing a saved game.
- Keep the architecture modular, test main interactions, and do not build the full simulation yet.

## Decisions
- Use the existing React 19, Vite, TypeScript project structure and installed geography/globe libraries.
- Use real `world-atlas` geography and D3/TopoJSON, Arabic-localized UI and data, and localStorage for saves.
- Clearly label setup-only values and estimates; advanced simulation systems remain future work.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing foundation includes game data, screens, components, styling, real-world map/globe, wizard steps, and local save/settings implementation.
- Project entry/config files and `src/game/draft.ts` are present.

### Active
- Add missing `src/App.tsx` and wire navigation, setup wizard, and game screen.
- Fix wizard step imports and missing labels module/import.
- Resolve TypeScript errors, then validate build and key interactions.

### Blocked
- `npm run build` currently fails with TypeScript errors; app cannot be validated until these are fixed.

## Next Move
1. Add `src/App.tsx` to satisfy `src/main.tsx`’s `./App` import and connect existing screens.
2. Correct step imports that reference `./parts` although the shared module is `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`; resolve missing `src/game/labels` imports.
3. Fix remaining build errors: optional country lookup values passed to `handleMove` in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`, and `latlng` tuple typing in `src/data/countries.ts`.
4. Run `npm run build`, then test setup, navigation, saves, settings, and responsive RTL behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: App entry; imports missing `./App`.
- `src/screens/wizard/`: Wizard steps and shared `parts.tsx`; current imports have unresolved paths.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: Draft creation, validation, and game-state construction.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: World, country, scenario, and government draft transformations.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Simulation clock, settings, notifications, and save state.
- `src/game/types.ts`: Core app and simulation types.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geography map; has TypeScript errors around optional country records.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: Country data typing and mappings; has a `latlng` tuple type error.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: Main menu navigation callbacks.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: Local save management UI.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: Scenario selection UI.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: Settings UI.
- `package.json`: Build command is `tsc --noEmit && vite build`.

## Important Context
- Latest `npm run build` output included: `Cannot find module './App'`, unresolved `../../../game/labels` and `./parts` imports, plus type errors in `WorldMap.tsx` and `countries.ts`.
- No browser or interaction tests have been reported; the recently written files remain unverified.

## Objective
- Complete نيـروز as a polished Arabic RTL foundation for a realistic country and civilization simulation.
- Deliver a working first version with setup, navigation, simulation controls, and local saves without presenting future systems as implemented.

## Requirements
- Premium, mobile-first Arabic RTL design with deep green, warm ivory, bronze, natural colors, and an immersive animated globe.
- Support real, fictional, custom, historical, and modern worlds; country selection should cover countries worldwide and use real geography.
- Provide a five-step setup wizard for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions, including Quick Start and Advanced Setup.
- Include functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events without fabricated systems.
- Provide pause/play, three speeds, date, notifications, and save controls; support multiple local saves and continuing a saved game.
- Keep the architecture modular, test main interactions, and do not build the full simulation yet.

## Decisions
- Use the existing React 19, Vite, TypeScript project structure and installed geography/globe libraries.
- Use real `world-atlas` geography and D3/TopoJSON, Arabic-localized UI and data, and localStorage for saves.
- Clearly label setup-only values and estimates; advanced simulation systems remain future work.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing foundation includes game data, screens, components, styling, real-world map/globe, wizard steps, and local save/settings implementation.
- Project entry/config files and `src/game/draft.ts` are present.

### Active
- Add missing `src/App.tsx` to satisfy `src/main.tsx`’s `./App` import and connect existing screens.
- Verify wizard imports and resolve any missing `src/game/labels` references if still present; the latest build output no longer reports these errors.
- Fix current TypeScript errors, then validate build and key interactions.

### Blocked
- `npm run build` fails on TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`, preventing app validation.

## Next Move
1. Add `src/App.tsx` and wire navigation, setup wizard, and game screen.
2. Fix optional `CountryRecord` values passed to `handleMove` in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`.
3. Resolve the `CountryRecord[]` assertion / `latlng` tuple typing issue in `src/data/countries.ts`.
4. Run `npm run build`, then test setup, navigation, saves, settings, and responsive RTL behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: App entry; imports missing `./App`.
- `src/screens/wizard/`: Setup steps and shared `parts.tsx`.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: Draft creation, validation, and game-state construction.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: World, country, scenario, and government draft transformations.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Simulation clock, settings, notifications, and save state.
- `src/game/types.ts`: Core app and simulation types.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geography map; current optional-record type errors.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: Country data and mappings; current country/coordinate typing errors.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: Main menu navigation callbacks.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: Local save management UI.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: Scenario selection UI.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: Settings UI.
- `package.json`: Build command is `tsc --noEmit && vite build`.

## Important Context
- Latest `npm run build` reports errors in `WorldMap.tsx` at lines 171–172 (`CountryRecord | null | undefined` passed where `CountryRecord | null` is expected) and `countries.ts` at line 5 (unsafe conversion to `CountryRecord[]`, including `latlng` typing).
- No browser or interaction tests have been reported; existing files remain unverified.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete نيـروز as a polished Arabic RTL foundation for a realistic country and civilization simulation.
- Deliver a working first version with setup, navigation, simulation controls, and local saves without presenting future systems as implemented.

## Requirements
- Premium, mobile-first Arabic RTL design with deep green, warm ivory, bronze, natural colors, and an immersive animated globe.
- Support real, fictional, custom, historical, and modern worlds; country selection should cover countries worldwide and use real geography.
- Provide a five-step setup wizard for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions, including Quick Start and Advanced Setup.
- Include functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events without fabricated systems.
- Provide pause/play, three speeds, date, notifications, and save controls; support multiple local saves and continuing a saved game.
- Keep the architecture modular, test main interactions, and do not build the full simulation yet.

## Decisions
- Use the existing React 19, Vite, TypeScript project structure and installed geography/globe libraries.
- Use real `world-atlas` geography and D3/TopoJSON, Arabic-localized UI and data, and localStorage for saves.
- Clearly label setup-only values and estimates; advanced simulation systems remain future work.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing foundation includes game data, screens, components, styling, real-world map/globe, wizard steps, and local save/settings implementation.
- Project entry/config files and `src/game/draft.ts` are present.

### Active
- Add missing `src/App.tsx` to satisfy `src/main.tsx`’s `./App` import and connect existing screens.
- Fix current TypeScript errors and validate the app build and key interactions.

### Blocked
- `npm run build` was reported failing on TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`, preventing app validation.

## Next Move
1. Add `src/App.tsx` and wire navigation, setup wizard, and game screen.
2. Fix optional `CountryRecord` values passed to `handleMove` in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`.
3. Resolve the `CountryRecord[]` assertion / `latlng` tuple typing issue in `src/data/countries.ts`.
4. Run `npm run build`, then test setup, navigation, saves, settings, and responsive RTL behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: App entry; imports missing `./App`.
- `src/screens/wizard/`: Setup steps and shared `parts.tsx`.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: Draft creation, validation, and game-state construction.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: World, country, scenario, and government draft transformations.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Simulation clock, settings, notifications, and save state.
- `src/game/types.ts`: Core app and simulation types.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geography map; reported optional-record type errors.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: Country data and mappings; reported country/coordinate typing errors.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: Main menu navigation callbacks.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: Local save management UI.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: Scenario selection UI.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: Settings UI.
- `package.json`: Build command is `tsc --noEmit && vite build`.

## Important Context
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/ConditionsStep.tsx` imports `DIFFICULTY_BY_ID` and `WORLDS_ABUNDANCE_LABEL` from `src/game/labels`; previous build output reportedly no longer showed this import as an error.
- No browser or interaction tests have been reported.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete نيـروز as a polished Arabic RTL foundation for a realistic country and civilization simulation.
- Deliver a working first version with setup, navigation, simulation controls, and local saves without presenting future systems as implemented.

## Requirements
- Premium, mobile-first Arabic RTL design with deep green, warm ivory, bronze, natural colors, and an immersive animated globe.
- Support real, fictional, custom, historical, and modern worlds; country selection should cover countries worldwide and use real geography.
- Provide a five-step setup wizard for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions, including Quick Start and Advanced Setup.
- Include functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events without fabricated systems.
- Provide pause/play, three speeds, date, notifications, and save controls; support multiple local saves and continuing a saved game.
- Keep the architecture modular, test main interactions, and do not build the full simulation yet.

## Decisions
- Use the existing React 19, Vite, TypeScript project structure and installed geography/globe libraries.
- Use real `world-atlas` geography and D3/TopoJSON, Arabic-localized UI and data, and localStorage for saves.
- Clearly label setup-only values and estimates; advanced simulation systems remain future work.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing foundation includes game data, screens, components, styling, real-world map/globe, wizard steps, and local save/settings implementation.
- Project entry/config files and `src/game/draft.ts` are present.

### Active
- Add missing `src/App.tsx` to satisfy `src/main.tsx`’s `./App` import and connect existing screens.
- Fix TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`.
- Validate the app build and key interactions.

### Blocked
- `npm run build` was reported failing on TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`, preventing app validation.

## Next Move
1. Add `src/App.tsx` and wire navigation, setup wizard, and game screen.
2. Fix optional `CountryRecord` values passed to `handleMove` in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`.
3. Resolve the `CountryRecord[]` assertion / `latlng` tuple typing issue in `src/data/countries.ts`.
4. Run `npm run build`, then test setup, navigation, saves, settings, and responsive RTL behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: App entry; imports missing `./App`.
- `src/game/types.ts`: Core app and simulation types.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: Draft creation, validation, and game-state construction.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: World, country, scenario, and government draft transformations.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Simulation clock, settings, notifications, and save state.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: Local saves and settings persistence.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geography map; reported optional-record type errors.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: Country data and mappings; reported country/coordinate typing errors.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: Main menu navigation callbacks.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: Local save management UI.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: Scenario selection UI.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: Settings UI.
- `src/screens/wizard/`: Wizard steps and shared UI.
- `package.json`: Build command is `tsc --noEmit && vite build`.

## Important Context
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/ConditionsStep.tsx` imports `DIFFICULTY_BY_ID` and `WORLDS_ABUNDANCE_LABEL` from `src/game/labels`; previous build output reportedly no longer showed this import as an error.
- No browser or interaction tests have been reported.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete نيـروز as a polished Arabic RTL foundation for a realistic country and civilization simulation.
- Deliver a working first version with setup, navigation, simulation controls, and local saves without presenting future systems as implemented.

## Requirements
- Premium, mobile-first Arabic RTL design with deep green, warm ivory, bronze, natural colors, and an immersive animated globe.
- Support real, fictional, custom, historical, and modern worlds; country selection should cover countries worldwide and use real geography.
- Provide a five-step setup wizard for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions, including Quick Start and Advanced Setup.
- Include functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events without fabricated systems.
- Provide pause/play, three speeds, date, notifications, and save controls; support multiple local saves and continuing a saved game.
- Keep the architecture modular, test main interactions, and do not build the full simulation yet.

## Decisions
- Use the existing React 19, Vite, TypeScript project structure and installed geography/globe libraries.
- Use real `world-atlas` geography and D3/TopoJSON, Arabic-localized UI and data, and localStorage for saves.
- Clearly label setup-only values and estimates; advanced simulation systems remain future work.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing foundation includes game data, screens, components, styling, real-world map/globe, wizard steps, and local save/settings implementation.
- Project entry/config files and `src/game/draft.ts` are present.

### Active
- Add missing `src/App.tsx` to satisfy `src/main.tsx`’s `./App` import and connect existing screens.
- Fix TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`.
- Validate the app build and key interactions.

### Blocked
- `npm run build` was reported failing on TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`, preventing app validation.

## Next Move
1. Add `src/App.tsx` and wire navigation, setup wizard, and game screen.
2. Fix optional `CountryRecord` values passed to `handleMove` in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`.
3. Resolve the `CountryRecord[]` assertion / `latlng` tuple typing issue in `src/data/countries.ts`.
4. Run `npm run build`, then test setup, navigation, saves, settings, and responsive RTL behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: App entry; imports missing `./App`.
- `src/game/types.ts`: Core app and simulation types.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: Draft creation, validation, and game-state construction.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: World, country, scenario, and government draft transformations.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Simulation clock, settings, notifications, and save state.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: Local saves and settings persistence.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geography map; reported optional-record type errors.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: Country data and mappings; reported country/coordinate typing errors.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: Main menu navigation callbacks.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: Local save management UI.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: Scenario selection UI.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: Settings UI.
- `src/screens/wizard/`: Wizard steps and shared UI.
- `package.json`: Build command is `tsc --noEmit && vite build`.

## Important Context
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/ConditionsStep.tsx` imports `DIFFICULTY_BY_ID` and `WORLDS_ABUNDANCE_LABEL` from `src/game/labels`; previous build output reportedly no longer showed this import as an error.
- No browser or interaction tests have been reported.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete نيـروز as a polished Arabic RTL foundation for a realistic country and civilization simulation, with working setup, navigation, simulation controls, and local saves.
- Keep the first version honest about what is implemented; do not present future simulation systems as complete.

## Requirements
- Premium, mobile-first Arabic RTL design with deep green, warm ivory, bronze, natural colors, and an immersive animated globe.
- Support real, fictional, custom, historical, and modern worlds; country selection should cover countries worldwide and use real geography.
- Provide a five-step setup wizard for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions, including Quick Start and Advanced Setup.
- Include functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events without fabricated systems.
- Provide pause/play, three speeds, date, notifications, and save controls; support multiple local saves and continuing a saved game.
- Keep the architecture modular, test main interactions, and do not build the full simulation yet.

## Decisions
- Use the existing React 19, Vite, TypeScript project structure and installed geography/globe libraries.
- Use real `world-atlas` geography and D3/TopoJSON, Arabic-localized UI and data, and localStorage for saves.
- Clearly label setup-only values and estimates; advanced simulation systems remain future work.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing foundation includes game data, screens, components, styling, real-world map/globe, wizard steps, and local save/settings implementation.
- Project entry/config files and `src/game/draft.ts` are present.

### Active
- Add missing `src/App.tsx` to satisfy `src/main.tsx`’s `./App` import and connect existing screens.
- Fix TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`.
- Validate the app build and key interactions.

### Blocked
- `npm run build` fails on TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`, preventing app validation.

## Next Move
1. Add `src/App.tsx` and wire navigation, setup wizard, and game screen.
2. Fix optional `CountryRecord` values passed to `handleMove` in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`.
3. Resolve the `CountryRecord[]` assertion / `latlng` tuple typing issue in `src/data/countries.ts`.
4. Run `npm run build`, then test setup, navigation, saves, settings, and responsive RTL behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: App entry; imports missing `./App`.
- `src/game/types.ts`: Core app and simulation types.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: Draft creation, validation, and game-state construction.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: World, country, scenario, and government draft transformations.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Simulation clock, settings, notifications, and save state.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: Local saves and settings persistence.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geography map; reported optional-record type errors.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: Country data and mappings; reported country/coordinate typing errors.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: Main menu navigation callbacks.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: Local save management UI.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: Scenario selection UI.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: Settings UI.
- `src/screens/wizard/`: Wizard steps and shared UI.
- `package.json`: Build command is `tsc --noEmit && vite build`.

## Important Context
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/ConditionsStep.tsx` imports `DIFFICULTY_BY_ID` and `WORLDS_ABUNDANCE_LABEL` from `src/game/labels`; previous build output reportedly no longer showed this import as an error.
- Latest reported errors: `WorldMap.tsx` lines 171–172 pass `CountryRecord | null | undefined` where `CountryRecord | null` is expected; `countries.ts` line 5 assertion from imported JSON to `CountryRecord[]` is rejected.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete نيـروز as a polished Arabic RTL foundation for a realistic country and civilization simulation, with working setup, navigation, simulation controls, and local saves.
- Keep the first version honest about what is implemented; do not present future simulation systems as complete.

## Requirements
- Premium, mobile-first Arabic RTL design with deep green, warm ivory, bronze, natural colors, and an immersive animated globe.
- Support real, fictional, custom, historical, and modern worlds; country selection should cover countries worldwide and use real geography.
- Provide a five-step setup wizard for world, country, identity, government, and starting conditions, including Quick Start and Advanced Setup.
- Include functional navigation for World, Government, Economy, Population, Infrastructure, Projects, Statistics, and Events without fabricated systems.
- Provide pause/play, three speeds, date, notifications, and save controls; support multiple local saves and continuing a saved game.
- Keep the architecture modular, test main interactions, and do not build the full simulation yet.

## Decisions
- Use the existing React 19, Vite, TypeScript project structure and installed geography/globe libraries.
- Use real `world-atlas` geography and D3/TopoJSON, Arabic-localized UI and data, and localStorage for saves.
- Clearly label setup-only values and estimates; advanced simulation systems remain future work.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing foundation includes game data, screens, components, styling, real-world map/globe, wizard steps, and local save/settings implementation.
- Project entry/config files and `src/game/draft.ts` are present.

### Active
- Add missing `src/App.tsx` to satisfy `src/main.tsx`’s `./App` import and connect existing screens.
- Fix TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`.
- Validate the app build and key interactions.

### Blocked
- `npm run build` reportedly fails on TypeScript errors in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx` and `src/data/countries.ts`, preventing app validation.

## Next Move
1. Add `src/App.tsx` and wire navigation, setup wizard, and game screen.
2. Fix optional `CountryRecord` values passed to `handleMove` in `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`.
3. Resolve the `CountryRecord[]` assertion / `latlng` tuple typing issue in `src/data/countries.ts`.
4. Run `npm run build`, then test setup, navigation, saves, settings, and responsive RTL behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: App entry; imports missing `./App`.
- `src/game/types.ts`: Core app and simulation types.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: Draft creation, validation, and game-state construction.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: World, country, scenario, and government draft transformations.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: Simulation clock, settings, notifications, and save state.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: Local saves and settings persistence.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: Real geography map; reported optional-record type errors.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: Country data and mappings; reported country/coordinate typing errors.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: Main menu navigation callbacks.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: Local save management UI.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: Scenario selection UI.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: Settings UI.
- `src/screens/wizard/`: Wizard steps and shared UI.
- `package.json`: Build command is `tsc --noEmit && vite build`.

## Important Context
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/ConditionsStep.tsx` imports `DIFFICULTY_BY_ID` and `WORLDS_ABUNDANCE_LABEL` from `src/game/labels`; previous build output reportedly no longer showed this import as an error.
- Latest reported errors: `WorldMap.tsx` lines 171–172 pass `CountryRecord | null | undefined` where `CountryRecord | null` is expected; `countries.ts` line 5 assertion from imported JSON to `CountryRecord[]` is rejected.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- إكمال نيـروز كأساس عربي RTL مصقول لمحاكاة دولة وحضارة، مع إعداد يعمل وتنقل وحفظ محلي.
- إبقاء النطاق صادقاً: لا تُعرض أنظمة المحاكاة المستقبلية كأنها مكتملة.

## Requirements
- تصميم عربي RTL متجاوب، بخريطة حقيقية، ومعالج إعداد من خمس خطوات.
- توفير التنقل والحفظ والتحكم بالوقت، مع توضيح ما هو إعداد أولي وما لم يُنفذ بعد.
- إصلاح البناء والتحقق من التفاعلات الأساسية، دون بناء المحاكاة الكاملة.

## Decisions
- الاستمرار على React وVite وTypeScript والبنية الحالية، مع بيانات جغرافية حقيقية وحفظ عبر `localStorage`.
- بناء شاشة لعبة أولية صريحة بشأن حدود المرحلة الحالية، لا أنظمة وهمية.

## Work State
### Completed
- تعديل `WorldMap.tsx` لتمرير `record ?? null` إلى `handleMove`.
- تعديل تحويل بيانات الدول في `countries.ts` إلى `raw as unknown as CountryRecord[]`.
- تشغيل `npm run build`؛ أكد أن هذين الخطأين لم يعودا ظاهرين.

### Active
- إضافة `src/App.tsx` لربط القائمة والإعدادات والسيناريوهات والحفظ والمعالج وشاشة اللعبة.
- إصلاح مراجع استيراد `parts.tsx` من ملفات الخطوات، وإضافة `src/game/labels.ts` المفقود.
- إعادة تشغيل البناء ثم اختبار التفاعلات الأساسية.

### Blocked
- البناء متوقف لأن `src/App.tsx` و`src/game/labels.ts` غير موجودين، ولأن خطوات المعالج تستورد `./parts` بينما الملف موجود في المجلد الأب.

## Next Move
1. إصلاح استيرادات `parts.tsx` في ملفات `src/screens/wizard/steps/` لتشير إلى الملف المشترك في المجلد الأب، وإضافة `src/game/labels.ts` بالتسميات التي تحتاجها `ConditionsStep.tsx`.
2. إنشاء `src/App.tsx` وربط الشاشات والمعالج ومزود اللعبة.
3. تشغيل `npm run build` ومعالجة أي أخطاء متبقية.
4. التحقق من إعداد لعبة، التنقل، الحفظ والاستعادة، والإعدادات والعرض المتجاوب RTL.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: نقطة الدخول وتستورد `./App` غير الموجود.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: حالة اللعبة والحفظ وإعدادات الساعة والإشعارات.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: إنشاء المسودة والتحقق منها وبناء حالة اللعبة.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: تغييرات العالم والدولة والسيناريو والحكم في المعالج.
- `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`: مكونات المعالج المشتركة، بينما الخطوات تستورد المسار الخاطئ حالياً.
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/`: خطوات المعالج الخمس؛ `ConditionsStep.tsx` يعتمد أيضاً على `game/labels`.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: واجهة القائمة ونقاط التنقل.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: واجهة إدارة الحفظ.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: واجهة السيناريوهات.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: واجهة الإعدادات.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: خريطة العالم؛ أُصلح تمرير السجل الاختياري.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: بيانات الدول وتحويل JSON؛ أُصلح التحويل النوعي.
- `src/styles/pages.css`: تتضمن أنماط صفحات اللعبة؛ قد تساعد في توصيل الشاشة الأولية.

## Important Context
- آخر أخطاء البناء المسجلة: `Cannot find module './App'`، و`Cannot find module '../../../game/labels'`، وأربعة أخطاء `Cannot find module './parts'` في ملفات خطوات المعالج.
- لا توجد شاشة لعبة أو مكوّن `App` في الملفات الحالية؛ المطلوب إنشاء ربط عملي، مع إبقاء الأنظمة غير المنفذة واضحة للمستخدم.
- التغييرات المذكورة غير مؤكدة الالتزام أو الدفع.

## Objective
- إكمال نيـروز كأساس عربي RTL مصقول لمحاكاة دولة وحضارة، مع تنقّل وحفظ محلي يعملان.
- تقديم شاشة لعبة أولية صريحة بحدود المرحلة، دون الادعاء بأن أنظمة المحاكاة المستقبلية مكتملة.

## Requirements
- واجهة عربية RTL متجاوبة، خريطة حقيقية، ومعالج إعداد من خمس خطوات.
- توفير التنقل والحفظ والتحكم بالوقت، مع توضيح ما هو إعداد أولي وما لم يُنفذ بعد.
- إصلاح البناء والتحقق من التفاعلات الأساسية، دون بناء المحاكاة الكاملة.

## Decisions
- الاستمرار على React وVite وTypeScript والبنية الحالية، مع بيانات جغرافية حقيقية وحفظ عبر `localStorage`.
- بناء شاشة لعبة أولية تُظهر حدود المرحلة الحالية بوضوح.

## Work State
### Completed
- تعديل `WorldMap.tsx` لتمرير `record ?? null` إلى `handleMove`.
- تعديل تحويل بيانات الدول في `countries.ts` إلى `raw as unknown as CountryRecord[]`.
- تشغيل `npm run build` لتحديد العوائق المتبقية.

### Active
- إصلاح استيرادات مكونات المعالج وإضافة التسميات المطلوبة.
- إنشاء `src/App.tsx` وربط الشاشات والمعالج ومزود اللعبة.
- إضافة شاشة اللعبة الأولية والتحقق من البناء والتفاعلات.

### Blocked
- البناء متوقف لغياب `src/App.tsx` و`src/game/labels.ts`.
- ملفات خطوات المعالج الأربعة تستورد `./parts`، بينما الملف المشترك موجود في `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`.

## Next Move
1. تصحيح استيرادات `parts.tsx` في ملفات `src/screens/wizard/steps/` وإضافة `src/game/labels.ts` بالتسميات التي تحتاجها `ConditionsStep.tsx`.
2. إنشاء `src/App.tsx` لربط القائمة والإعدادات والسيناريوهات والحفظ والمعالج وشاشة اللعبة.
3. تشغيل `npm run build` ومعالجة الأخطاء المتبقية.
4. التحقق من إعداد لعبة والتنقل والحفظ والاستعادة والإعدادات والعرض المتجاوب RTL.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: نقطة الدخول وتستورد `./App` غير الموجود.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: حالة اللعبة والحفظ وإعدادات الساعة والإشعارات.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: إنشاء المسودة والتحقق منها وبناء حالة اللعبة.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: تغييرات العالم والدولة والسيناريو والحكم في المعالج.
- `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`: مكونات المعالج المشتركة.
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/`: خطوات المعالج الخمس؛ فيها استيرادات `./parts` غير الصحيحة.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: واجهة القائمة ونقاط التنقل.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: واجهة إدارة الحفظ.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: واجهة السيناريوهات.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: واجهة الإعدادات.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: خريطة العالم؛ أُصلح تمرير السجل الاختياري.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: بيانات الدول؛ أُصلح التحويل النوعي.
- `src/styles/pages.css`: أنماط صفحات اللعبة.

## Important Context
- آخر أخطاء البناء: `Cannot find module './App'`، و`Cannot find module '../../../game/labels'`، وأربعة أخطاء `Cannot find module './parts'`.
- لا توجد شاشة لعبة أو مكوّن `App` في الملفات الحالية.
- التغييرات غير مؤكدة الالتزام أو الدفع.

## Objective
- إكمال نيـروز كأساس عربي RTL مصقول لمحاكاة دولة وحضارة، مع تنقّل وحفظ محلي يعملان.
- تقديم شاشة لعبة أولية صريحة بحدود المرحلة، دون الادعاء بأن أنظمة المحاكاة المستقبلية مكتملة.

## Requirements
- واجهة عربية RTL متجاوبة، خريطة حقيقية، ومعالج إعداد من خمس خطوات.
- توفير التنقل والحفظ والتحكم بالوقت، مع توضيح ما هو إعداد أولي وما لم يُنفذ بعد.
- إصلاح البناء والتحقق من التفاعلات الأساسية، دون بناء المحاكاة الكاملة.

## Decisions
- الاستمرار على React وVite وTypeScript والبنية الحالية، مع بيانات جغرافية حقيقية وحفظ عبر `localStorage`.
- بناء شاشة لعبة أولية تُظهر حدود المرحلة الحالية بوضوح.

## Work State
### Completed
- تعديل `WorldMap.tsx` لتمرير `record ?? null` إلى `handleMove`.
- تعديل تحويل بيانات الدول في `countries.ts` إلى `raw as unknown as CountryRecord[]`.
- تشغيل `npm run build` لتحديد العوائق المتبقية.

### Active
- استكمال ربط القائمة والإعدادات والسيناريوهات والحفظ والمعالج ومزود اللعبة عبر `src/App.tsx`.
- إضافة شاشة اللعبة الأولية والتحقق من البناء والتفاعلات.

### Blocked
- البناء متوقف لغياب `src/App.tsx` و`src/game/labels.ts`.
- ملفات خطوات المعالج الأربعة تستورد `./parts`، بينما الملف المشترك موجود في `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`.

## Next Move
1. تصحيح استيرادات `parts.tsx` في ملفات `src/screens/wizard/steps/` وإضافة `src/game/labels.ts` بالتسميات التي تحتاجها `ConditionsStep.tsx`.
2. إنشاء `src/App.tsx` لربط القائمة والتنقل والشاشات ومزود اللعبة.
3. تشغيل `npm run build` ومعالجة الأخطاء المتبقية.
4. التحقق من إعداد لعبة والتنقل والحفظ والاستعادة والإعدادات والعرض المتجاوب RTL.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: نقطة الدخول وتستورد `./App` غير الموجود.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: حالة اللعبة والحفظ وإعدادات الساعة والإشعارات.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: إنشاء المسودة والتحقق منها وبناء حالة اللعبة.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: تغييرات العالم والدولة والسيناريو والحكم في المعالج.
- `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`: مكونات المعالج المشتركة.
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/`: خطوات المعالج الخمس واستيراداتها المشتركة.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: واجهة القائمة ونقاط التنقل.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: واجهة إدارة الحفظ.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: واجهة السيناريوهات.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: واجهة الإعدادات.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: الخريطة؛ أُصلح تمرير السجل الاختياري.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: بيانات الدول؛ أُصلح التحويل النوعي.
- `src/styles/pages.css`: أنماط صفحات اللعبة.

## Important Context
- آخر أخطاء البناء المعروفة: `Cannot find module './App'`، و`Cannot find module '../../../game/labels'`، وأربعة أخطاء `Cannot find module './parts'`.
- لا توجد شاشة لعبة أو مكوّن `App` في الملفات الحالية.
- التغييرات غير مؤكدة الالتزام أو الدفع.

## Objective
- إكمال نيـروز كأساس عربي RTL مصقول لمحاكاة دولة وحضارة، مع تنقّل وحفظ محلي يعملان.
- تقديم شاشة لعبة أولية توضّح حدود المرحلة الحالية من دون الادعاء بأن أنظمة المحاكاة المستقبلية مكتملة.

## Requirements
- واجهة عربية RTL متجاوبة، خريطة حقيقية، ومعالج إعداد من خمس خطوات.
- توفير التنقل والحفظ والتحكم بالوقت، مع توضيح ما هو إعداد أولي وما لم يُنفذ بعد.
- إصلاح البناء والتحقق من التفاعلات الأساسية، دون بناء المحاكاة الكاملة.

## Decisions
- الاستمرار على React وVite وTypeScript والبنية الحالية، مع بيانات جغرافية حقيقية وحفظ عبر `localStorage`.
- بناء شاشة لعبة أولية تُظهر حدود المرحلة الحالية بوضوح.

## Work State
### Completed
- تعديل `WorldMap.tsx` لتمرير `record ?? null` إلى `handleMove`.
- تعديل تحويل بيانات الدول في `countries.ts` إلى `raw as unknown as CountryRecord[]`.
- تشغيل `npm run build` ورصد أخطاء البناء المتبقية.

### Active
- استكمال ربط القائمة والإعدادات والسيناريوهات والحفظ والمعالج ومزود اللعبة عبر `src/App.tsx`.
- إصلاح استيرادات مكونات المعالج وإضافة تسميات اللعبة الناقصة.
- إضافة شاشة اللعبة الأولية والتحقق من البناء والتفاعلات.

### Blocked
- البناء متوقف لغياب `src/App.tsx` و`src/game/labels.ts`.
- ملفات خطوات المعالج تستورد `./parts`، بينما الملف المشترك موجود في `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`.

## Next Move
1. تصحيح استيرادات `parts.tsx` في ملفات `src/screens/wizard/steps/` وإضافة `src/game/labels.ts` بالتسميات التي تحتاجها `ConditionsStep.tsx`.
2. إنشاء `src/App.tsx` لربط القائمة والتنقل والشاشات ومزود اللعبة.
3. تشغيل `npm run build` ومعالجة الأخطاء المتبقية.
4. التحقق من إعداد لعبة والتنقل والحفظ والاستعادة والإعدادات والعرض المتجاوب RTL.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: نقطة الدخول وتستورد `./App` غير الموجود.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: حالة اللعبة والحفظ وإعدادات الساعة والإشعارات.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: إنشاء المسودة والتحقق منها وبناء حالة اللعبة.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: تغييرات العالم والدولة والسيناريو والحكم في المعالج.
- `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`: مكونات المعالج المشتركة.
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/`: خطوات المعالج الخمس واستيراداتها المشتركة.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: واجهة القائمة ونقاط التنقل.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: واجهة إدارة الحفظ.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: واجهة السيناريوهات.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: واجهة الإعدادات.
- `src/screens/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx`: عناصر الإعدادات وإدارة البيانات المحلية.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: الخريطة؛ أُصلح تمرير السجل الاختياري.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: بيانات الدول؛ أُصلح التحويل النوعي.
- `src/data/worlds.ts`: يتضمن `DIFFICULTY_BY_ID` المستخدم في شاشة السيناريوهات.

## Important Context
- آخر أخطاء البناء المعروفة: `Cannot find module './App'`، و`Cannot find module '../../../game/labels'`، وأربعة أخطاء `Cannot find module './parts'`.
- لا توجد شاشة لعبة أو مكوّن `App` في الملفات الحالية.
- التغييرات غير مؤكدة الالتزام أو الدفع.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- إكمال نيـروز كأساس عربي RTL مصقول لمحاكاة دولة وحضارة، مع تنقّل وحفظ محلي يعملان.
- تقديم شاشة لعبة أولية توضّح حدود المرحلة الحالية من دون الادعاء بأن أنظمة المحاكاة المستقبلية مكتملة.

## Requirements
- واجهة عربية RTL متجاوبة، خريطة حقيقية، ومعالج إعداد من خمس خطوات.
- توفير التنقل والحفظ والتحكم بالوقت، مع توضيح ما هو إعداد أولي وما لم يُنفذ بعد.
- إصلاح البناء والتحقق من التفاعلات الأساسية، دون بناء المحاكاة الكاملة.

## Decisions
- الاستمرار على React وVite وTypeScript والبنية الحالية، مع بيانات جغرافية حقيقية وحفظ عبر `localStorage`.
- بناء شاشة لعبة أولية تُظهر حدود المرحلة الحالية بوضوح.

## Work State
### Completed
- تعديل `WorldMap.tsx` لتمرير `record ?? null` إلى `handleMove`.
- تعديل تحويل بيانات الدول في `countries.ts` إلى `raw as unknown as CountryRecord[]`.
- فحص مكونات اللعبة والإعداد والمعالج والقائمة والحفظ والإعدادات لتحديد نقاط الربط المطلوبة.

### Active
- استكمال ربط القائمة والإعدادات والسيناريوهات والحفظ والمعالج ومزود اللعبة عبر `src/App.tsx`.
- إصلاح استيرادات مكونات المعالج وإضافة تسميات اللعبة الناقصة.
- إضافة شاشة اللعبة الأولية والتحقق من البناء والتفاعلات.

### Blocked
- البناء متوقف لغياب `src/App.tsx` و`src/game/labels.ts`.
- ملفات خطوات المعالج تستورد `./parts`، بينما الملف المشترك موجود في `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`.

## Next Move
1. تصحيح استيرادات `parts.tsx` في ملفات `src/screens/wizard/steps/` وإضافة `src/game/labels.ts` بالتسميات التي تحتاجها `ConditionsStep.tsx`.
2. إنشاء `src/App.tsx` لربط القائمة والتنقل والشاشات ومزود اللعبة.
3. تشغيل `npm run build` ومعالجة الأخطاء المتبقية.
4. التحقق من إعداد لعبة والتنقل والحفظ والاستعادة والإعدادات والعرض المتجاوب RTL.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: نقطة الدخول وتستورد `./App` غير الموجود.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: حالة اللعبة والحفظ وإعدادات الساعة والإشعارات.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: إنشاء المسودة والتحقق منها وبناء حالة اللعبة.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: تغييرات العالم والدولة والسيناريو والحكم في المعالج.
- `src/game/types.ts`: أنواع الشاشات وحالة اللعبة والإعدادات.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: التخزين المحلي للحفظ والإعدادات.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: واجهة القائمة ونقاط التنقل.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: واجهة إدارة الحفظ.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: واجهة السيناريوهات.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: واجهة الإعدادات.
- `src/screens/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx`: عناصر الإعدادات وإدارة البيانات المحلية.
- `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`: مكونات المعالج المشتركة.
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/`: خطوات المعالج الخمس واستيراداتها المشتركة.
- `src/components/WorldMap.tsx`: الخريطة؛ أُصلح تمرير السجل الاختياري.
- `src/data/countries.ts`: بيانات الدول؛ أُصلح التحويل النوعي.

## Important Context
- آخر أخطاء البناء المعروفة: `Cannot find module './App'`، و`Cannot find module '../../../game/labels'`، وأربعة أخطاء `Cannot find module './parts'`.
- لا توجد شاشة لعبة أو مكوّن `App` في الملفات الحالية.
- التغييرات غير مؤكدة الالتزام أو الدفع.

## Objective
- إكمال نيـروز كأساس عربي RTL مصقول لمحاكاة دولة وحضارة، مع تنقّل وحفظ محلي يعملان.
- تقديم شاشة لعبة أولية توضّح حدود المرحلة الحالية من دون الادعاء بأن أنظمة المحاكاة المستقبلية مكتملة.

## Requirements
- واجهة عربية RTL متجاوبة، خريطة حقيقية، ومعالج إعداد من خمس خطوات.
- توفير التنقل والحفظ والتحكم بالوقت، مع توضيح ما هو إعداد أولي وما لم يُنفذ بعد.
- إصلاح البناء والتحقق من التفاعلات الأساسية، دون بناء المحاكاة الكاملة.

## Decisions
- الاستمرار على React وVite وTypeScript والبنية الحالية، مع بيانات جغرافية حقيقية وحفظ عبر `localStorage`.
- بناء شاشة لعبة أولية تُظهر حدود المرحلة الحالية بوضوح.

## Work State
### Completed
- تعديل `WorldMap.tsx` لتمرير `record ?? null` إلى `handleMove`.
- تعديل تحويل بيانات الدول في `countries.ts` إلى `raw as unknown as CountryRecord[]`.
- فحص مكونات اللعبة والإعداد والمعالج والقائمة والحفظ والإعدادات لتحديد نقاط الربط المطلوبة.

### Active
- استكمال ربط القائمة والإعدادات والسيناريوهات والحفظ والمعالج ومزود اللعبة عبر `src/App.tsx`.
- إصلاح استيرادات مكونات المعالج وإضافة تسميات اللعبة الناقصة.
- إضافة شاشة اللعبة الأولية والتحقق من البناء والتفاعلات.

### Blocked
- البناء متوقف لغياب `src/App.tsx` و`src/game/labels.ts`.
- ملفات خطوات المعالج تستورد `./parts`، بينما الملف المشترك موجود في `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`.

## Next Move
1. تصحيح استيرادات `parts.tsx` في ملفات `src/screens/wizard/steps/` وإضافة `src/game/labels.ts` بالتسميات التي تحتاجها `ConditionsStep.tsx`.
2. إنشاء `src/App.tsx` لربط القائمة والتنقل والشاشات ومزود اللعبة.
3. تشغيل `npm run build` ومعالجة الأخطاء المتبقية.
4. التحقق من إعداد لعبة والتنقل والحفظ والاستعادة والإعدادات والعرض المتجاوب RTL.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: نقطة الدخول وتستورد `./App` غير الموجود.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: حالة اللعبة والحفظ وإعدادات الساعة والإشعارات.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: إنشاء المسودة والتحقق منها وبناء حالة اللعبة.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: تغييرات العالم والدولة والسيناريو والحكم في المعالج.
- `src/game/types.ts`: أنواع الشاشات وحالة اللعبة والإعدادات.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: التخزين المحلي للحفظ والإعدادات.
- `src/data/worlds.ts`: بيانات العوالم وتسميات الصعوبة الموجودة.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: واجهة القائمة ونقاط التنقل.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: واجهة إدارة الحفظ.

## Objective
- إكمال نيـروز كأساس عربي RTL مصقول لمحاكاة دولة وحضارة، مع تنقّل وحفظ محلي يعملان.
- تقديم شاشة لعبة أولية توضّح حدود المرحلة الحالية من دون الادعاء بأن أنظمة المحاكاة المستقبلية مكتملة.

## Requirements
- واجهة عربية RTL متجاوبة، خريطة حقيقية، ومعالج إعداد من خمس خطوات.
- توفير التنقل والحفظ والتحكم بالوقت، مع توضيح ما هو إعداد أولي وما لم يُنفذ بعد.
- إصلاح البناء والتحقق من التفاعلات الأساسية، دون بناء المحاكاة الكاملة.

## Decisions
- الاستمرار على React وVite وTypeScript والبنية الحالية، مع بيانات جغرافية حقيقية وحفظ عبر `localStorage`.
- بناء شاشة لعبة أولية تُظهر حدود المرحلة الحالية بوضوح.

## Work State
### Completed
- تعديل `WorldMap.tsx` لتمرير `record ?? null` إلى `handleMove`.
- تعديل تحويل بيانات الدول في `countries.ts` إلى `raw as unknown as CountryRecord[]`.
- فحص مكونات اللعبة والإعداد والمعالج والقائمة والحفظ والإعدادات لتحديد نقاط الربط المطلوبة.

### Active
- استكمال ربط القائمة والإعدادات والسيناريوهات والحفظ والمعالج ومزود اللعبة عبر `src/App.tsx`.
- إصلاح استيرادات مكونات المعالج وإضافة تسميات اللعبة الناقصة.
- إضافة شاشة اللعبة الأولية والتحقق من البناء والتفاعلات.

### Blocked
- البناء متوقف لغياب `src/App.tsx` و`src/game/labels.ts`.
- ملفات خطوات المعالج تستورد `./parts`، بينما الملف المشترك موجود في `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`.
- لم يُعثر على `WizardScreen.tsx`؛ يلزم إنشاءه أو ربط خطوات المعالج مباشرةً في مسار التطبيق.

## Next Move
1. تصحيح استيرادات `parts.tsx` في ملفات `src/screens/wizard/steps/` وإضافة `src/game/labels.ts` بالتسميات التي تحتاجها `ConditionsStep.tsx`.
2. إنشاء شاشة المعالج ذات الخطوات الخمس، ثم إنشاء `src/App.tsx` لربط القائمة والتنقل والشاشات ومزود اللعبة.
3. تشغيل `npm run build` ومعالجة الأخطاء المتبقية.
4. التحقق من إعداد لعبة والتنقل والحفظ والاستعادة والإعدادات والعرض المتجاوب RTL.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: نقطة الدخول وتستورد `./App` غير الموجود.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: حالة اللعبة والحفظ وإعدادات الساعة والإشعارات.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: إنشاء المسودة والتحقق منها وبناء حالة اللعبة.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: تغييرات العالم والدولة والسيناريو والحكم في المعالج.
- `src/game/types.ts`: أنواع الشاشات وحالة اللعبة والإعدادات.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: التخزين المحلي للحفظ والإعدادات.
- `src/data/worlds.ts`: بيانات العوالم وتسميات الصعوبة الموجودة.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: واجهة القائمة ونقاط التنقل.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: واجهة إدارة الحفظ.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: واجهة السيناريوهات.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: واجهة الإعدادات.
- `src/screens/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx`: عناصر الإعدادات وإدارة البيانات المحلية.
- `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`: مكونات المعالج المشتركة.
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/`: خطوات المعالج الخمس واستيراداتها المشتركة.
- `src/styles/game.css`: أنماط شاشة اللعبة الأولية.

## Important Context
- آخر أخطاء البناء المعروفة: `Cannot find module './App'`، `Cannot find module '../../../game/labels'`، وأربعة `Cannot find module './parts'`.
- لا توجد شاشة لعبة أو مكوّن `App` في الملفات الحالية.
- `DIFFICULTY_BY_ID` موجود في `src/data/worlds.ts`، لكن `WORLDS_ABUNDANCE_LABEL` غير ظاهر ضمن نتائج البحث في `src/data`.
- التغييرات غير مؤكدة الالتزام أو الدفع.

## Objective
- إكمال نيـروز كأساس عربي RTL مصقول لمحاكاة دولة وحضارة، مع تنقّل وحفظ محلي يعملان.
- تقديم شاشة لعبة أولية توضّح حدود المرحلة الحالية من دون الادعاء بأن أنظمة المحاكاة المستقبلية مكتملة.

## Requirements
- واجهة عربية RTL متجاوبة، خريطة حقيقية، ومعالج إعداد من خمس خطوات.
- توفير التنقل والحفظ والتحكم بالوقت، مع توضيح ما هو إعداد أولي وما لم يُنفذ بعد.
- إصلاح البناء والتحقق من التفاعلات الأساسية، دون بناء المحاكاة الكاملة.

## Decisions
- الاستمرار على React وVite وTypeScript والبنية الحالية، مع بيانات جغرافية حقيقية وحفظ عبر `localStorage`.
- بناء شاشة لعبة أولية تُظهر حدود المرحلة الحالية بوضوح.

## Work State
### Completed
- تعديل `WorldMap.tsx` لتمرير `record ?? null` إلى `handleMove`.
- تعديل تحويل بيانات الدول في `countries.ts` إلى `raw as unknown as CountryRecord[]`.
- فحص مكونات اللعبة والإعداد والمعالج والقائمة والحفظ والإعدادات لتحديد نقاط الربط المطلوبة.

### Active
- استكمال ربط القائمة والإعدادات والسيناريوهات والحفظ والمعالج ومزود اللعبة عبر `src/App.tsx`.
- إصلاح استيرادات مكونات المعالج وإضافة تسميات اللعبة الناقصة.
- إضافة شاشة اللعبة الأولية والتحقق من البناء والتفاعلات.

### Blocked
- البناء متوقف لغياب `src/App.tsx` و`src/game/labels.ts`.
- ملفات خطوات المعالج تستورد `./parts`، بينما الملف المشترك موجود في `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`.
- لم يُعثر على `WizardScreen.tsx`؛ يلزم إنشاءه أو ربط خطوات المعالج مباشرةً في مسار التطبيق.

## Next Move
1. تصحيح استيرادات `parts.tsx` في ملفات `src/screens/wizard/steps/` وإضافة `src/game/labels.ts` بالتسميات التي تحتاجها `ConditionsStep.tsx`.
2. إنشاء شاشة المعالج ذات الخطوات الخمس، ثم إنشاء `src/App.tsx` لربط القائمة والتنقل والشاشات ومزود اللعبة.
3. تشغيل `npm run build` ومعالجة الأخطاء المتبقية.
4. التحقق من إعداد لعبة والتنقل والحفظ والاستعادة والإعدادات والعرض المتجاوب RTL.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.tsx`: نقطة الدخول وتستورد `./App` غير الموجود.
- `src/game/GameProvider.tsx`: حالة اللعبة والحفظ وإعدادات الساعة والإشعارات.
- `src/game/setup.ts`: إنشاء المسودة والتحقق منها وبناء حالة اللعبة.
- `src/game/draft.ts`: تغييرات العالم والدولة والسيناريو والحكم في المعالج.
- `src/game/types.ts`: أنواع الشاشات وحالة اللعبة والإعدادات.
- `src/game/storage.ts`: التخزين المحلي للحفظ والإعدادات.
- `src/data/worlds.ts`: بيانات العوالم وتسميات الصعوبة الموجودة.
- `src/screens/MainMenu.tsx`: واجهة القائمة ونقاط التنقل.
- `src/screens/SavesScreen.tsx`: واجهة إدارة الحفظ.
- `src/screens/ScenariosScreen.tsx`: واجهة السيناريوهات.
- `src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx`: واجهة الإعدادات.
- `src/screens/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx`: عناصر الإعدادات وإدارة البيانات المحلية.
- `src/screens/wizard/parts.tsx`: مكونات المعالج المشتركة.
- `src/screens/wizard/steps/`: خطوات المعالج الخمس واستيراداتها المشتركة.
- `src/styles/game.css`: أنماط شاشة اللعبة الأولية.

## Important Context
- آخر أخطاء البناء المعروفة: `Cannot find module './App'`، `Cannot find module '../../../game/labels'`، وأربعة `Cannot find module './parts'`.
- لا توجد شاشة لعبة أو مكوّن `App` في الملفات الحالية.
- `DIFFICULTY_BY_ID` موجود في `src/data/worlds.ts`، لكن `WORLDS_ABUNDANCE_LABEL` غير ظاهر ضمن نتائج البحث في `src/data`.
- التغييرات غير مؤكدة الالتزام أو الدفع.
